test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 30 days. Together with C they can complete the same work in 24 days. In how many days can C alone complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can do a piece of work in 30 days. 

Together A, B, and C can complete the same work in 24 days.

**Calculations:**

Work done by (A + B) in one day = 1/30

Work done by (A + B + C) in one day = 1/24

Work done by (C) in one day = Work done by (A + B + C) in one day - Work done by (A + B) in one day 

⇒ (1/24) - (1/30) 

⇒ (5 - 4)/120 = 1/120

**∴ C alone complete the same work in 120 days.**
